name: skip-list
description: Probabilistic ordered linked list providing O(log N) average-case search, insert, and delete without tree rotations.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a sorted dynamic set with O(log N) operations and a simpler implementation than balanced BSTs. Ideal for in-memory ordered indexes, leaderboards, and range queries.

parameters.name: maxLevel
parameters.description: Maximum number of levels in the skip list (default 16). Higher values improve performance for very large datasets.

parameters.name: probability
parameters.description: Probability factor for level promotion (default 0.5). Controls the trade-off between space and speed.
